scope: Application clarification after a parsed nonreply action fails source validation, following all existing source-specific recoveries.
trigger: Only a validation exception for a parsed nonreply decision sets rejectedAction. A reply route, malformed routing, cancellation or generation error does not set it.
priority: Existing interaction evidence, saved-question/reminder/reading/symptom drafts and preservation acknowledgements retain priority and their existing review/save requirements.

disposition.english: I couldn’t prepare that action from your message. Please rephrase it or use the Records tab.
disposition.french: Je n’ai pas pu préparer cette action à partir de votre message. Reformulez votre demande ou utilisez l’onglet Dossier.

provenance: Raw route, tool and validation failure stay unchanged in ModelEval and ModelProbe. The effective reply and applicationDecision are recorded separately. No model prose is generated for this clarification; it earns no raw routing, prose or independent extraction credit.
language: The app passes its current language to both source validation and the fallback disposition.
limitations: An ordinary reply route without existing source-specific recovery still generates model prose.
This scope records behavior to validate, not passed correctness, model quality, device performance or release results.
unchangedRequirements: Source validators, model prompts, assets, generation budgets, sampler and Automatic default are unchanged by this amendment.
Frozen fixtures, scorer, qualitative criteria and original default-promotion gate remain unchanged.
Revised-source correctness, app/build evidence and complete paired model evaluations and reviews remain required before Ready.
